Eur. 6.2 (Human Antithrombin III Concentrate; Antithrombi- num III Humanum Densatum). A preparation of a glycoprotein fraction obtained from human plasma that inactivates thrombin in the presence of an excess of heparin. The plasma is obtained from healthy donors and is tested for the absence of hepatitis B surface antigen and antibodies against HIV-1 and HIV-2 and hepatitis C virus.
